english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the highest permitted or possible limit.

exampleSentences.english: The daily withdrawal maximum on this credit card is twenty thousand dollars.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢張信用卡每日提款上限係兩萬蚊。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaa1 mui5 jat6 tai4 fun2 soeng6 haan6 hai6 loeng5 maan6 man1

english.note: Use this specifically for the highest permitted amount, level, or number.

exampleSentences.english: The daily spending limit on this card is five thousand dollars.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢張卡每日消費上限係五千蚊。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 kaa1 mui5 jat6 siu1 fai3 soeng6 haan6 hai6 ng5 cin1 man1

english.note: Use this for the general upper limit of an object, quantity, or action rather than a physical ceiling.

exampleSentences.english: The ceiling for this plan is one hundred people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個計劃嘅上限係一百人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 soeng6 haan6 hai6 jat1 baak3 jan4

english.note: Use this for an imposed upper limit such as a salary or spending ceiling.

exampleSentences.english: The spending cap on this credit card is twenty thousand dollars.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢張信用卡嘅消費上限係兩萬蚊。
